edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims between them on the terms set forth in this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the Settlement Amount of $[●] (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date, in accordance with payment instructions provided by Plaintiff in writing.

2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims that Plaintiff has or may have, whether known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the matters resolved by this Agreement and existing through the Effective Date. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its attorneys, accountants, insurers, and other professional advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations, or as required by law, court order, or governmental process. A party required to disclose shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice.
